title: 5 Apache-2.0 Susi Core pillars (ACP open socket + parallel Susi Harness), remote pull & merge on every workflow step, and deterministic release distillation
goal: Deliver CEO Directives #2, #4, #5, and #8 in Apache-2.0 Susi Core: (1) complete and expose all 5 core pillars (`GAWD`, `GEMI`, `GMCP`, `ACP` via `susi_core::acp` + canonical port `9094` mounting in `susi-gawd-a2a`, and `Susi Harness` via `susi_harness::workflow_runner`) with zero third-party vendor bloat; (2) enforce pure-Git remote pull & merge reconciliation (`git fetch --prune` + fast-forward or conflict-checked 3-way merge with offline fallback) across every workflow step (`start`, `sync`/`step`, `commit`, `distill`, `ship`, `release`) in both `susi-harness` and `xtask` `local-workflow`; and (3) upgrade `xtask` `distill` and `local-distill` with `--pull` reconciliation, `refs/candidates/release/<name>` CAS candidate refs, and layout-valid `releases/<tag>.json` (`susi-release-record/v1`) snapshot emission.
acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p xtask --bin distill --bin local-distill --bin local-workflow

cargo test --offline --locked --test five_pillars_workflow --test lean_core_ceilings --test architecture_tests --test no_console_window --test no_github_coupling --test orphan_sources --test task_records --test release_records --test release_workflow --test socket_boundary --test socket_parity --test duplication_tests --test core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins

acp_open_socket.capability_admission: MacPolicy (HostOnly & Balanced capability grants + workspace confinement)

xtask_workflow_and_distillation.local_workflow: remote pull & 3-way merge reconciliation with offline fallback on start, sync/step, commit, distill, ship, and release
xtask_workflow_and_distillation.distill: --pull remote reconciliation, refs/candidates/release/<name> CAS refs, and releases/<tag>.json (susi-release-record/v1) snapshot emission
